instructions: Read ANTIGRAVITY_BRIDGE.md and docs/RADIOLOGIST_REPORT_SPEC.md from origin/agent-control before execution.
Verify code.base_sha exactly. Create antigravity/radar-20260923-002 from f1637cbdb840e77fd2d7d2d24fda84b33060a84f.
Do not use Prima for any part of this task.
GATE A: implement a fully offline radiologist-readable HTML report from RADAR CSV/model output.
Create a maintainable Vietnamese organ/finding terminology mapping for all 146 findings, preserving the English label as secondary metadata.
Default HTML must show Top 12 findings overall ranked by model score, grouped by organ, with up to Top 3 per organ and a collapsible full 146-finding table.
Use the wording 'Điểm mô hình'. Explicitly state it is not a calibrated disease probability.
Do not label findings positive/negative and do not impose a universal clinical cutoff such as 0.5.
Add safe offline search/filter/toggle controls without CDN or network calls.
Ensure HTML escapes all input text and uses safe relative/local links only.
Add regression tests for score sorting, Vietnamese label mapping coverage, HTML escaping, no external network assets, and demo-case expected ranking.
Render the upstream public demo and verify high-ranked entries match the reference ordering, including cardiomegaly, aortic calcification, and atherosclerosis near their known scores.
Only after Gate A tests and demo rendering pass, proceed to GATE B.
GATE B: process local alias LOCAL_CASE_001 only if it exists in local Antigravity configuration. The real filesystem path must never be committed or written into GitHub results.
Extract the ZIP to a local-only runtime directory. Inventory DICOM series locally without logging patient-identifying fields to GitHub.
Select eligible diagnostic abdominal contrast-enhanced CT series according to docs/RADIOLOGIST_REPORT_SPEC.md. Exclude scouts/localizers/dose reports/derived screenshots.
If multiple eligible contrast phases exist, process them separately rather than silently selecting one or averaging across phases.
Convert eligible DICOM series locally to NIfTI using dcm2niix or equivalent. Use safe neutral filenames such as LOCAL_CASE_001_SERIES_01.nii.gz.
Run the optimized RTX 4060 inference path with default ROI and FP16 for each eligible series.
Render a local RADAR_report.html for each processed series or a single multi-series HTML with clearly separated series sections.
Keep all extracted DICOM, converted NIfTI, CSV, HTML and screenshots outside the Git repository and Git-ignored.

GitHub terminal result must contain only aggregate non-PHI operational data: number of candidate/eligible/processed series, success/failure, runtime, peak VRAM, and a sanitized local output alias. Do not include patient name, original ZIP path, SeriesDescription strings containing PHI, raw findings, or model scores from the real patient.
If LOCAL_CASE_001 is not configured locally, finish Gate A, mark Gate B blocked with a concise instruction to configure the alias locally, and do not fabricate a patient test.
Push code/tests/docs to the working branch and open a PR to main. Do not merge.

acceptance: A new working branch antigravity/radar-20260923-002 exists
HTML report is fully offline and clinically readable
All 146 findings have Vietnamese labels or an explicit tested fallback with no Chinese-only display in the main UI
The UI uses model score terminology and contains a visible not-calibrated-probability warning
No universal positive/negative threshold is applied
Demo regression tests pass and high-ranked findings match the reference CSV ordering
LOCAL_CASE_001 is processed only after Gate A passes and only from a local alias
Multiple eligible contrast phases, if present, are handled separately
No PHI, patient files, patient scores, or patient report content are pushed to GitHub
A PR is opened but not merged
A terminal result is pushed to .antigravity/results/RADAR-20260923-002.json
